title: PACK HIT check (NOT TONIGHT; DRAFT; agent slot, hidden desktop OK, NOT timing): Agent 4, REPIN.md section 4. Traced n0 on native4b (t0) and on the pack bin native4bp (t0p)
notes: NOT TONIGHT (Agent 1, task #12, 19:41): the pack bin needs the user's visual-check yes first (build/agent4/r2t6/VISUAL-CHECK.md). Adapted 2026-11-22 19:55 from the 14:40 draft (native5 / native5p) so it is ready if the yes comes: t0 on build/agent2/native4b-bin (tonight's pin candidate, S4b + S4c) and t0p on build/agent2/native4bp-bin, a PLACEHOLDER for the folder Agent 2 would stage. Until native4bp-bin has a MANIFEST.txt, run-matrix skips its arm.

Run it only after Agent 1's GO, once native4bp-bin is staged and repin_check.ps1 -Line snap1 -Pack -BinDir build\agent2\native4bp-bin shows the 4 pack hashes in the prelinked cache: bench\agent8\run\run-matrix.ps1 -Matrix build\agent4\repin\matrix-repin-packhit.json -NoPrompt -OutDir build\agent3\runs\repin-packhit-<stamp> (always pass -OutDir: without it the output goes to build\agent8\matrix and trips Agent 1's HOLD). 2 runs, about 12 min.

Both arms are traced: LEGO_NATIVE_TRACE_DIR=<run>\trace (the game creates the dir: long_probe.h:49). A trace turns off buffer/texture reuse and some draw fast paths, so traced runs pair only with traced runs. Only the bin differs between the arms. With the trace on, the game also saves a present frame every 5 s (device.cpp:2533-2548), and VISUAL-CHECK 3.3 can reuse those frames.

Pass: t0 is the positive control. Its events.tsv has draw_missing_vertex_shader / draw_missing_pixel_shader rows, and its game.log has the placement 'missing from AOT index' lines (native4 n0: VS 0xAC449538 x4, PS 0xAC448F28 x4); without them the check is void, not passed. t0p must have 0 draw_missing_* rows, no placement 'missing from AOT index' line and no 'unrecognized ... resource' line for the packed addresses. Its draws per frame p10/p50/p90 must be >= t0's, check_n_rows.py --baseline t0 --rows t0p=<dir> must exit 0, and it must close cleanly on WM_CLOSE.
On a fail, send both run dirs to Agent 4 and Agent 2 (VISUAL-CHECK.md section 5). The pack bin is parked, and the pin stays on native4b.
